The `source` array references the package's own upstream GitHub release, which is expected behavior. The `package()` function is defined but will not execute during `makepkg --printsrcinfo` since that command only sources the top-level scope and does not run pkgver/prepare/build/package. There are no eval, base64, curl, wget, or other dangerous commands at the top level. No code exfiltrates data or downloads and executes untrusted payloads during the parse step.
</details>
